name: Cloudflare DNS
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools that let an agent manage Cloudflare DNS via the Cloudflare API — verify the token, list zones (domains), and read, create, update, patch, and delete DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, SRV, NS, etc.). Authenticated by a single scoped CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (needs Zone:Read and DNS:Edit).
